payload.author: claude
payload.body: Verified account/session/password-reset/grant/invitation stores on PgSqlDriver (5/5 conformance on real PG16). Two portability fixes: AccountStore COLLATE NOCASE -> LOWER(handle)=LOWER(?); GrantStore.isEmptyAsync EXISTS()===0 -> !present (SQLite int vs PG boolean). SQLite suite still 781 green. test:pg widened with pg-identity.
